sources.title: On some p-adic properties and supercongruences of Delannoy and Schr�der numbers
sources.overlap: Formulates the exact basepoint and shifted-difference conjectures and settles low congruence classes. Direct problem source, not a prior proof of the full conjectures.

sources.authors: R.-H. Wang; M. X. X. Zhong
sources.title: Congruences for sums of Delannoy numbers and polynomials; published title includes Legendre polynomials
sources.overlap: Gives the D(2^a+1) congruence whose consecutive differences imply the b=u=1 case. This case must be credited as already known. Does not state our arbitrary-index pair classification or exact interpolant image.

sources.authors: M. A. Alekseyev; T. Amdeberhan; J. Shallit; I. Vukusic
sources.title: On the p-adic valuations of values of Legendre polynomials
sources.overlap: Theorem 3 assumes v_p(r)>=1. The p=3, r=3 case treats valuations of D(N) itself. This is distinct from v2 of differences at argument 3; v2(3)=0 does not satisfy that hypothesis.

sources.authors: F. Beukers; M. Houben; A. Straub
sources.title: Gauss congruences for rational functions in several variables
sources.overlap: Proves shifted Gauss divisibility congruences for the two-variable Delannoy array at all primes. Example 5.7 does not give the exact full pair valuations or the interpolant image.
